rows.grounds: past passive participle describing the ritual state of the worshipper
bahuvrīhi compound: dhṛta (held/worn) + dhauta (washed) + ambara (garment) + dvaya (pair)

items.question: What preparatory physical and mental condition qualifies a worshipper to receive the prescribed ritual procedure?
premises: The worshipper must have completed ritual bathing.
The worshipper must be ritually pure.
The worshipper must have a restrained mind.
The worshipper must wear two washed garments.
items.inference: A worshipper who fulfills these bodily and mental conditions is properly prepared for the prescribed worship.
items.plain_english: Having bathed, pure, with a restrained mind, and wearing two washed garments.
